facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports Mozambique is preparing a National Digital Transformation Strategy with the International Telecommunication Union, having launched the process in February 2026, to coordinate initiatives that now span several strategies and sector projects; as_of is the publication date.

Ecofin Agency reports the government is still preparing a three-year operational plan to define the actions, results and costs of the digital transformation, and that the plan must still set financing requirements and expected results; as_of is the publication date.

systems.tiers: national; calls for unified service portal, standardised systems and common interoperability infrastructure
